headline: US AI Chip Export Restrictions Risk Slowing ASEAN Data Center Expansion
summary: Tighter US restrictions on technology exports threaten to slow data center development in Malaysia and Thailand as infrastructure suppliers face supply chain bottlenecks.
why: Southeast Asia has become a major regional destination for hyperscale data center capital expenditure; trade curbs directly affect cloud infrastructure timelines.

impacts.name: Malaysia
impacts.why: Export controls on advanced chips risk delaying tech infrastructure projects and FDI intake.
